_note: Cloudflare Turnstile on the booking, partners, careers and club forms (Ahmed, 4 Nov 2026 — DECISIONS.md «Pre-launch fixes, commit 2»). ON since 5 Nov 2026 (the widget covers armadaresidence.com and its subdomains — www included; armadaresidence.github.io was needed only until launch day, 8 Nov 2026, and can be removed from the widget's hostnames). With enabled false (or no site_key) the pages load nothing and the functions verify nothing. The secret is the Supabase secret TURNSTILE_SECRET_KEY (never in the repo); a change here = rebuild + redeploy booking-request, job-application and club. The widget's mode (Managed or Invisible) is chosen in Cloudflare's dashboard; the pages render it with appearance interaction-only, so a person sees it only when Cloudflare asks for a click.
